name: hero-monitor
title: Hero monitor
description: Dot-rendered terminal containing an animated demo.
usage: A product page hero's demo when it sits in a data flow: the story goes in as `children`. `caseAttributes` and `caseOverlay` line things up with the screen, such as the data flow's anchor.
avoid: Content other than a 58 by 38 dot story on the screen
A monitor and the blue demo card in one hero
